_meta.description: Hand-labeled SR conclusion-sentence fixtures for the ConcordanceMap classifier benchmark. Synthetic/paraphrased abstracts written to exercise the deterministic classifier; NOT drawn from real PMIDs. Labels are the ground truth used to measure classifier accuracy in scripts/benchmark.py.
_meta.cluster_note: cluster_id groups fixtures into synthetic PICO clusters so the benchmark can also exercise concordance_engine end-to-end. These clusters are illustrative, not empirical findings.
